title: Equivalence between signs and three blocks
statement: For any type $A$, a sign-valued function on $\{0,1,2\}\times A$ is equivalent to a triple of sign-valued functions on $A$, obtained by restricting the first coordinate to $0$, $1$, and $2$. The inverse assembles the three functions into one function on the product.
